_note: Inputs to the 8/2 walking/standing block split, generated by `python -m Analysis.davidson_power.power tradeoff`.

gain._what: Power of the confirmatory phase-agnostic population test vs walking trials per participant (power.population_power, Holm over 2 and 4 cps).

cost_threshold._what: SD of the fixed-slope Weibull ML 75 % threshold (the estimator threshold_by_condition uses) vs standing trials, levels at the rig's 65/75/85 % points mixed 0.05/0.85/0.10.

cost_h2._what: Power of H2, the crossover model's walking-vs-standing contrast on log10 threshold (one-sample t, N = 12), at the adopted 1 standing + 4 walking blocks per visit.
